title: WKS-17 Location Compliance Check Sheet Template
description: Canonical, versioned representation of a location compliance check sheet derived verbatim from the WorkSafe NZ Location Compliance Certification Performance Standard. This file is the single source of truth; TypeScript types, Dart models, Postgres seeds and PDF/XLSX exports are all generated from it and must never be hand-edited.

title.description: Verbatim sheet title as it appears in the source workbook

psReference.description: The Performance Standard this content is taken from

classScope.description: Hazard classes this template applies to, e.g. ["6.1A","6.1B","8.2A"]. Empty for the general template, which applies to every job.

revision.description: Increments when WorkSafe revises the Performance Standard. Templates are immutable once published; a revision creates a new document.

source.description: Provenance of this extraction, so the content can be re-verified against its origin.

number.description: Section number as printed on the sheet
Item number within the section, as printed

regulationRefs.description: Parsed regulation references, e.g. ["10.34","13.38"]. Parsed rather than free text so items can be linked to legislation and audited for coverage.

regulationRaw.description: The Regulation cell exactly as written, retained because the parse is lossy

action.description: Verbatim 'Action' column — what the certifier must verify

records.description: Verbatim 'Records' column — what must be recorded as evidence

evidenceRequired.description: Derived: the Records cell calls for photographs, copies or samples
